svg.title: From the dsh queue to a task's history
svg.desc: Annotated excerpts from two historical live-host captures, not a desktop screenshot or synchronized task state. Original proportions are preserved. Queue outcomes, append delivery and notification receipts answer different questions.
svg.text: From the queue to a task’s history
Real interface excerpts • two historical captures • original proportions
Read the queue, inspect instructions, then separate the result from its delivery.
Allowance windows sit above each agent’s queue.
Outcome chips and send receipts are separate.
The queue and detail show different tasks.
Amounts and states belong to those captures.
Full originals are linked below the figure.
Submit with the runner; inspect delivery here.
Completed work can still have a failed notification.
This task finished; its timeline records WeChat sent and Telegram failed. Older tasks may have gaps.
